title: Social Posts Content Manager
name: Social Posts Content Manager
subtitle: Review the exact post. Make a clear decision. Move on.
summary: A native editorial workspace for LinkedIn, Bluesky and Markdown articles, with destination previews, version-bound approval and a private Mac generation service.
oneLiner: Review social drafts and run Mac-backed article workflows from iPhone and iPad.
description: Review LinkedIn and Bluesky text separately, see which destinations will receive it, and inspect the selected publication image before deciding. Persistent Mark Ready and Reject & Next controls keep the review queue moving. Edits and approval use the same Notion data as the Mac app.
story: Content creation and publishing already had independent local backends. This app adds a focused editorial interface: the Mac handles generation and articles, while iPhone and iPad keep review and decisions close at hand. Approval binds to the reviewed content; it does not immediately publish.

assets.label: iPhone: publication previews for LinkedIn and Bluesky
iPhone: fictional scheduled and published posts in Calendar
iPad: publication preview and approval controls

caseStudy.problem: An editor needs to see exactly what each destination will receive and continue work from another device.
caseStudy.role: I built the native Mac and mobile editorial interfaces, version-bound approval, and the mobile connection to generation.
architecture: Social review uses an existing Notion database. The generation service runs longer jobs on a paired Mac and reports progress to mobile.
Article Studio can send selected context to the Mac and open the resulting draft in the mobile workflow.
validation: A physical iPhone loaded the live calendar and followed a Mac-backed article preparation job. The public browser demo runs on fictional drafts.
